scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../app/resqher-mobile && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd app/resqher-mobile && npx expo start"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd app/resqher-mobile && npx expo start --ios"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd app/resqher-mobile && npx expo start --tunnel"
